requirements: R1: Mount PrivacySettings.svelte within the application UI and connect its export and delete actions to the real API.
R2: Remove the incorrectly committed target build artifacts and design-check screenshots.

slices.title: Fix Data Subject Rights UI Mount and Cleanup
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to mount PrivacySettings and wire its API, so that the privacy controls are actually reachable and functional.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user views their settings, When the page loads, Then clear options to export and delete data are presented in Russian because PrivacySettings is mounted.
Given a user chooses to delete their account, When they confirm the severe warning, Then the action uses the real API instead of mock timeouts.
Given the repository state, When inspected, Then no design-check screenshots or target build artifacts remain, with tests verifying integration.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unreachable UI components from 1 to 0
